d: TURALI GROUP is a diversified Turkish industrial group with operations in Türkiye, Germany and China. We design and manufacture hydraulic and pneumatic systems, precision metal parts, custom machinery and software solutions for the defense, aerospace and heavy industry sectors.
We are expanding in the Gulf and are looking for a Regional Manager based in Kuwait to build and grow our presence in the country.
You will represent TURALI GROUP in Kuwait, find and develop new business, and act as the main link between local customers and our engineering and production teams in Türkiye. The position is remote.
q: Based in Kuwait with valid residency and work eligibility
3+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in industrial, defense, oil & gas or engineering sectors
An established network in Kuwait's public and industrial sectors
Experience with tender processes in Kuwait
Fluent English; Arabic is a strong advantage.
Self-driven and comfortable working independently with a remote team
r: li
Identify and develop opportunities in oil & gas, energy, infrastructure and industrial sectors in Kuwait
li
Build long-term relationships with end users, EPC contractors, distributors and government bodies
li
Follow public and private tenders, collect requirements, and coordinate offer preparation with our HQ teams
li
Find and manage local partners and agents where needed
li
Represent the group at exhibitions, customer meetings and industry events
x: Apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to abdylla@turaligroup.com with the subject line "Regional Manager – Kuwait".

d: Introducing Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain, an extraordinary addition to Raffles Hotel's renowned portfolio. This ultra-luxury property offers a unique experience as "The Palace of the Secret Garden." With 78 private pool villas ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain redefines luxury hospitality in Bahrain. Our spacious villas, starting from 400 sqm, feature private pools and jacuzzis, providing guests with ultimate relaxation and privacy. Our dedicated team of Raffles Legendary Butlers ensures exceptional service and attention to detail, creating unforgettable moments for each guest. Conveniently located just 40 minutes from the airport and 30 minutes from the City Center, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain offers easy access to Exhibition World Bahrain, Bahrain International Circuit (BIC), and the Al Dana Amphitheater, making it an ideal choice for cultural, entertainment, and business destinations.

To support and execute the hotel's PR and communications strategy, strengthening the visibility and positioning of Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain across Bahrain and the GCC. The role will manage day-to-day media relations, influencer engagement, partnerships, press communications and PR activations across the hotel, F&B, Spa & Wellness and key experiences, working closely with the Marketing Manager and Commercial team.
q: 3-5 years of experience in PR, communications or luxury lifestyle/hospitality.
Previous experience within luxury hospitality, lifestyle, F&B or a reputable PR agency is preferred.
Strong existing relationships with Bahrain media, influencers, brands and key personalities; a GCC network is a strong advantage.
Good understanding of the Bahrain and GCC luxury, hospitality and lifestyle landscape.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
Confident in developing press materials and communicating with senior media and external partners.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and activations simultaneously.
Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to identify PR opportunities rather than relying solely on incoming requests.
Comfortable representing Raffles externally at media events, networking opportunities and industry activations.
Good understanding of social media and influencer marketing from a PR and brand reputation perspective.
Opportunity to join the first Raffles in Bahrain
Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
r: li
Manage day-to-day PR and communications activities across the hotel and its outlets.
li
Build and maintain strong relationships with key media, editors, journalists, influencers, content creators and relevant personalities in Bahrain and the GCC.
li
Proactively identify PR opportunities, partnerships, collaborations and relevant cultural or community activations that strengthen the hotel's positioning.
li
Develop and maintain an updated Bahrain and GCC media and influencer database.
li
Draft and coordinate press releases, media alerts, invitations, fact sheets and other PR materials in line with Raffles brand standards.
li
Coordinate media visits, influencer stays, interviews, photoshoots and hosted experiences, including agreed deliverables and follow-up.
li
Support PR activity for hotel experiences, restaurants, Spa & Wellness, events, seasonal campaigns and new launches.
li
Build relationships with relevant luxury, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, automotive and other brands to develop meaningful collaboration opportunities.
li
Support the planning and execution of media events, launches and PR activations.
li
Proactively pitch hotel stories, experiences and key personalities to relevant local, regional and international media.
li
Coordinate award submissions and luxury hospitality recognitions relevant to the hotel, F&B and Spa.
li
Monitor media coverage and prepare regular PR reports covering coverage, reach, media value, influencer activity and key outcomes.
li
Work closely with the Marketing team to align PR activity with the content calendar, social media, campaigns and commercial priorities.

Liaise with corporate and regional PR teams as required and ensure communications follow Raffles and Accor brand guidelines.

Monitor hospitality, luxury and lifestyle trends and identify opportunities to keep the hotel visible, relevant and competitive.
